title: TimeFormatException in ActivityLogService.java
description:
The application displays incorrect timestamps for user activity after the latest update.

TimeFormatException at ActivityLogService.java:92

User activity is being stored correctly, but the dashboard displays timestamps several hours earlier than the actual event time. The issue appears to occur when converting UTC timestamps to the user's local timezone.
stack_trace:
The application displays incorrect timestamps for user activity after the latest update.

TimeFormatException at ActivityLogService.java:92

User activity is being stored correctly, but the dashboard displays timestamps several hours earlier than the actual event time. The issue appears to occur when converting UTC timestamps to the user's local timezone.
root_cause: Incorrect date format pattern used when parsing UTC timestamps, causing TimeFormatException and wrong timezone conversion.
resolution: Update the UTC parsing logic in `ActivityLogService.java` to use the ISO‑8601 pattern `"yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"` (or `DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT`) and explicitly set the parsed `Instant` to UTC. Then convert that `Instant` to the user’s local zone using `ZonedDateTime.ofInstant(instant, userZone)` before formatting for display. This corrects the format mismatch that caused the `TimeFormatException` and ensures accurate timezone conversion.
